Case: Tamika is a 75-year-old who presents to your primary care clinic with progressive neck and arm pain. The pain started 2 months ago and is primarily axial and exacerbated with neck movement. Tamika denies any numbness or weakness, but has had difficulty with her balance and hand dexterity along with shooting pains down her arms.
